claimBoundary: Questionnaire-independent within the published integer single-choice profile and allowlisted workflows/scorers. The no-code path supports 1-20 items on one shared integer scale with mean, sum and optional reverse scoring. It is not compatible with every questionnaire and is not evidence of permission, psychometric validity, equivalence or disability-group benefit.
